symbolDescription: Every icon the editor draws, keyed by name. Supply a replacement by passing a component for that name to `icons`; it receives the same props as the built-in, which renders a 24×24 SVG that inherits `currentColor`.

optionDescriptions.alert: A triangle with an exclamation mark, for error and warning messages.
optionDescriptions.align: Alternating long and short lines, the alignment menu trigger.
optionDescriptions.alignCenter: Stacked lines centred on the axis.
optionDescriptions.alignJustify: Stacked lines of equal length, flush on both sides.
optionDescriptions.alignLeft: Stacked lines flush left, ragged right.
optionDescriptions.alignRight: Stacked lines flush right, ragged left.
optionDescriptions.backgroundColor: A marker pen over a colour bar, for the highlight picker.
optionDescriptions.blockType: A capital H, the same glyph as `heading`, opening the block-type menu.
optionDescriptions.bulletList: Three lines, each preceded by a dot.
optionDescriptions.check: A tick, marking the selected item in a menu.
optionDescriptions.checkList: Three lines, each preceded by a tick box.
optionDescriptions.chevronDown: A solid triangle pointing down, on a control that opens a menu below it.
optionDescriptions.chevronRight: A solid triangle pointing right, on a control that expands in place.
optionDescriptions.clearFormatting: A letterform with a diagonal slash through it.
optionDescriptions.close: A cross, dismissing a popover or a panel.
optionDescriptions.codeBlock: Angle brackets in a frame, for a fenced code block.
optionDescriptions.color: A capital A over a colour bar, for the text-colour picker.
optionDescriptions.dragHandle: Two columns of dots, the grip on a draggable block.
optionDescriptions.emoji: A smiling face, opening the emoji picker.
optionDescriptions.exitFullscreen: Four arrows pointing inward, leaving fullscreen.
optionDescriptions.external: An arrow leaving a box, marking a link that opens elsewhere.
optionDescriptions.findReplace: A magnifier beside a curved arrow.
optionDescriptions.fontFamily: A capital A, the typeface menu trigger.
optionDescriptions.fontSize: Two capital As of different sizes, the size menu trigger.
optionDescriptions.fullscreen: Four arrows pointing outward, entering fullscreen.
optionDescriptions.heading: A capital H.
optionDescriptions.horizontalRule: A single horizontal line, inserting a divider.
optionDescriptions.image: A picture frame with a mountain range inside.
optionDescriptions.indent: Lines with an arrow pointing right, increasing the indent.
optionDescriptions.mention: An at sign, opening the mention menu.
optionDescriptions.mergeTag: A pair of braces, inserting a merge tag.
optionDescriptions.more: Three dots in a row, opening the items the toolbar could not fit.
optionDescriptions.orderedList: Three lines, each preceded by a number.
optionDescriptions.outdent: Lines with an arrow pointing left, decreasing the indent.
optionDescriptions.sourceView: Angle brackets, the same glyph as `code`, switching to the HTML source.
optionDescriptions.spinner: A broken ring, drawn rotating while something is in flight.
optionDescriptions.strike: A letterform struck through by a horizontal rule.
optionDescriptions.subscript: A capital X with a small figure below the baseline.
optionDescriptions.superscript: A capital X with a small figure above the line.
optionDescriptions.underline: A capital U above a rule.
optionDescriptions.unlink: A broken chain link, removing a link.
optionDescriptions.wordCount: Four lines of alternating length, for the counter in the footer.
